summary: Native Android release 0.5.17 (versionCode 19): ships the Android work merged since 0.5.16. Diagrams and charts drawn in chat through the bundled visual host (chat-visuals.json), merge-back rows plus Send back, Edit and Discard on phones (fork-merge-back.json), chat-list search ranked like Go to chat (go-to-chat.json), pull request link provenance and unlink (pr-link-improvements.json), the handoff note on an agent switch, Stop, held-queue and expired-card recovery, queued-message data-loss fixes, and the model catalog fix for GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4.

desktop.reason: Android version bump only; the desktop parts of each shipped feature are covered by that feature's own manifest.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client has its own OTA and build lanes; this bump touches only apps/android.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No API change; the backend contracts these Android features use are covered by their own manifests.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes in this bump.

notExercised: Installing the update on a physical device through the in-app updater.
